intent: Let a user choose exactly one option from a small, always-visible set of mutually exclusive choices.
avoid_when: more than ~6 options, or the list needs to scroll (use select)
a11y_contract: built on React Aria RadioGroup/Radio: roving-tabindex arrow-key navigation and checked-state semantics come for free; the group itself still needs an aria-label or a visible label element since RadioGroup has no default accessible name
requires_data: 2+ options with visible text labels; a group-level label or aria-label
